summary: Iteration 33 — PRE-FIX baseline diagnostic reproduction. Read-only DB + real-module invocations + live UI capture. NO source changes. Regenerated the six code-level bugs still active in ubl.ts / b2g.ts / bonuses.ts / payroll.ts, verified two are already partially patched (normalizeStatus reject-first ordering; unsupported adjustments now throws a friendly message via B2G_ADJUSTMENT_ERROR instead of a raw 500). Confirmed live UI: hydration mismatch on /invoices/new (line id randomness), settings tab-URL is not source-of-truth, and confirmed credit-note sign inconsistency in the invoice list. SQLite integrity is clean — 0 FK violations, 0 cross-org invoices, 0 duplicate issued numbers, 0 invoice totals mismatch, 0 leave overlaps, 0 GL journal imbalance across 337 invoices / 496 lines / 6 orgs / 100 customers.

ubl_credit_note_root.verdict: BUG — ubl.ts:132-133 compute root/lineTag correctly but ubl.ts:184/164/166 use hardcoded <Invoice>/<cac:InvoiceLine>/<cbc:InvoicedQuantity>. BT-25 (BillingReference) is never emitted despite correlatedInvoiceId being present.

br24_price_line_extension.verdict: BUG — PEPPOL BR-24 requires PriceAmount × Quantity == LineExtensionAmount. ubl.ts:162 rounds unitPrice to 2 decimals. Fix: use base_quantity or emit price with 4-6 decimals.

unsupported_b2g_adjustments.throw_message: Το B2G για παρακρατήσεις/χαρτόσημο χρειάζεται επαληθευμένη αντιστοίχιση του παρόχου. Δεν δημιουργείται ούτε αποστέλλεται XML με ασυνεπή σύνολα.
unsupported_b2g_adjustments.verdict: PARTIAL — the raw 500 has been replaced with a user-facing message string (ubl.ts:130). Server actions/route handlers still need to catch it and validateB2G still does NOT preemptively guard (imported but not called).

validateB2G_cancelled.verdict: BUG — services/b2g.ts:23 only rejects status==='draft'. cancelled/void invoices pass validation.

normalizeStatus.verdict: PARTIAL — reject-first ordering FIXED since iter31/32 (not accepted / unsuccessful now correctly rejected). Still buggy: anchored regex misses common provider strings like 'Accepted by entity', 'ΑΠΟΔΕΚΤΟ', 'Sent to buyer', 'PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED' → all fall through to pending.

leaveAllowance_endDate.verdict: BUG — bonuses.ts:93 ignores emp.endDate; terminated employees receive full-year allowance identical to full-year workers.

computeItem_salaried_days.verdict: BUG — payroll.ts:157 uses shift-row COUNT as `days` for salaried employees. A monthly-salaried employee with 1 shift row gets €48 instead of €1200.

frontend_reproductions.hydration_mismatch_invoices_new: CONFIRMED — React hydration error: label htmlFor / input id differ between server (qty-l1789401710757-0) and client (qty-l1789401711417-0). Root cause: InvoiceEditor generates line ids via a client-only counter/Math.random, not a deterministic seed. Affects /invoices/new and any page using InvoiceEditor.
frontend_reproductions.settings_url_tab_not_source_of_truth: CONFIRMED — after clicking «Διασυνδέσεις & API» URL becomes ?tab=developer. Clicking «Τιμολόγηση» tab afterwards leaves URL at ?tab=developer (mixed <TabsTrigger asChild Link> vs regular TabsTrigger; defaultValue not value). settings/page.tsx:119-126.
frontend_reproductions.invoices_list_credit_sign_inconsistency: CONFIRMED — ΠΤ-0001: Καθαρό «200,00 €» (positive) while Σύνολο «-248,00 €» (negative). U2 in audit_fabble still active.
frontend_reproductions.mobile_390_invoices_overflow: NO horizontal doc scroll on /invoices at 390×844 (docWidth=390=viewport). Page renders a card layout on mobile. Note: the underlying <table> element scrollWidth=614 but is wrapped in overflow container; iter30 finding of full-page horizontal scroll appears MITIGATED. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/iter33_mobile_invoices.jpeg.
frontend_reproductions.login_hydration: NO hydration errors detected on /login page load or during login flow.

critical.issue: Emits root <Invoice> + <InvoiceLine> + InvoicedQuantity + InvoiceTypeCode>381 for credit notes; must be <CreditNote xmlns=CreditNote-2> + <CreditNoteLine> + <CreditedQuantity> + <CreditNoteTypeCode>. Also no <cac:BillingReference> (BT-25) even though correlatedInvoiceId exists.
BR-24 violation: unitPrice rounded to 2 decimals → PriceAmount × Quantity (33.33×3=99.99) ≠ LineExtensionAmount (100.00). Use BaseQuantity or emit PriceAmount with 4-6 decimals.
Uses shift COUNT as `days` for salaried employees — monthly-salaried with 1 shift → gross 48€ instead of 1200€.

high.issue: Anchored regex misses common provider strings ('Accepted by entity', 'ΑΠΟΔΕΚΤΟ', 'Sent to buyer', 'PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED', 'delivered' works). Add case-insensitive contains-checks or explicit map per provider.
Ignores emp.endDate entirely — terminated employees receive full-year allowance.

No guard for status in ('cancelled','void'); imports hasUnsupportedB2GAdjustments/B2G_ADJUSTMENT_ERROR but never calls them, so users still hit the throw at XML build time instead of a pre-send validation error.

minor.issue: SEPA credit transfer regardless of actual invoice payment method; missing <cac:PaymentTerms>, <cbc:PaymentDueDate>, <cac:AllowanceCharge>, <cac:WithholdingTaxTotal>, <cbc:AccountingCost>.
Strict regex ^[123]\|.+ blocks resend; PEPPOL BIS 3.0 treats project reference as optional — should be warning, not error.

ui_bugs.issue: SSR/client hydration mismatch: line item htmlFor/id (qty-*, price-*, disc-*) are generated non-deterministically → React re-renders and won't patch; potential wrong initial values and lost focus

2 of 15 tabs use asChild <Link> so URL becomes ?tab=developer, but subsequent tab clicks (not links) don't update URL. defaultValue not `value`. Confirmed: click 'Διασυνδέσεις & API' then click 'Τιμολόγηση' → URL stays ?tab=developer.
Credit note ΠΤ-0001 shows Καθαρό 200,00 € (positive) but Σύνολο -248,00 € (negative). Sign inconsistency between columns.

positive_findings: SQLite integrity_check=ok, no FK violations, no cross-org leaks between invoices/customers/lines/payments
No duplicate (org_id, series_code, number) tuples in issued/paid invoices
All 337 issued/paid invoices have net+vat-withheld+stamp ≈ gross (0 mismatches beyond ±0.02)
No overlapping approved/pending leave_requests for the same employee
GL entries all balanced (0 out of all entries with |debit-credit|>0.01)
normalizeStatus reject-first ordering has been fixed since iter31/32 (regression protected by new test)
athensIso now emits correct +02:00/+03:00 wall-clock offset (fixed since iter31/32)
buildPeppolInvoiceXml with withholding no longer throws a raw exception — a user-friendly message string is used (still needs try/catch upstream)
Mobile 390×844 /invoices no longer overflows the document (card layout kicks in). iter30 U3 appears mitigated.
critical_code_review_comments: ubl.ts:184 root element `<Invoice ...>` is hardcoded — the correctly-computed `root` (line 132) is dead code. Same for `lineTag` (line 133).
ubl.ts:162 `unitPrice = round2(netValue / quantity)` is the direct cause of BR-24 failures for any quantity>1 producing non-terminating decimals.
ubl.ts:224 PaymentMeansCode='58' is not derived from invoice.paymentMethod.
services/b2g.ts imports hasUnsupportedB2GAdjustments and B2G_ADJUSTMENT_ERROR (line 8) but neither is invoked inside validateB2G — dead imports, live footgun.
services/b2g.ts:23 status guard is `=== 'draft'` only. Should also block cancelled/void.
bonuses.ts:93 leaveAllowance is inconsistent with easterBonus/christmasBonus which correctly use daysWithin({hire..endDate}, year).
payroll.ts:157 couples shift-row count with days for salaried; must branch on contractType/grossSalary.
settings/page.tsx:119-126 mixes <TabsTrigger asChild><Link>> with plain <TabsTrigger>; uses defaultValue not value. URL is not a source of truth.
InvoiceEditor line-item id generation is not SSR-safe (Math.random or Date.now()-based). Must use useId() or a stable seed.
